facts.business: Atlantaa Limited is an infrastructure company engaged in road construction, tollway operations, and real estate development through its subsidiaries.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with subsidiaries (Atlanta Infra Assets Limited, MORA Tollways Limited, Atlanta Ropar Tollways Private Ltd.), promoter group entities (Shree Vaibhavlakshmi Properties Pvt.Ltd, Shreenath Builders, etc.), KMPs (Rajhoo Bbarot, Rickiin Bbarot, Dipesh Gogri), and relatives of KMPs. Includes loans, advances, receivables, and write-offs.
